newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Cargill says Ukraine oilseed plant deal nearer.
newsitem.headline: Cargill says Ukraine oilseed plant deal nearer.

text.p: The head of U.S. food and commodities group Cargill Enterprises Inc said on Tuesday the company's large oilseed refinery in Ukraine could be running by 1998.

"The first stage would be in excess of $40 million with construction by spring and the plant in operation by the summer of 1998," chairman Ernest Micek told reporters after meeting Ukraine's President Leonid Kuchma.
Micek said the two sides had to reach a land-lease agreement first, which he expected would be done by the end of the year.
"We need assurances of the President and staff that we can get total cooperation for permits and other things necessary for a project of this size," said Micek.
The plant is expected to process 120,000-200,000 tonnes of sunflower seed annually and produce oil, margarine and other foods.
Ukraine, expected to harvest two million tonnes of sunflower seed this year, is a large sunflower seed producer and oil exporter.
